question: What is an IFSC and why do you need it?
draft: The IFSC is the 11-character branch code found on your cheque book or banking app, consisting of four letters followed by a zero and six digits or letters [cod-refunds]. We require this code along with your account number and the account holder's name to process refunds for cash-on-delivery orders [cod-refunds]. Please provide these details directly in your reply rather than sending photos. Note that we will never ask for your card number, PIN, OTP, UPI PIN, or net banking password; if anyone requests these, please contact us immediately at support@tidewater.example [cod-refunds].

question: Can I wash my waterproof backpack in the machine?
draft:

Instead, wipe it with a soft brush, lukewarm water, and mild soap, then rinse thoroughly [backpack-care]. After every trip, empty the bag, rinse with fresh water if exposed to salt, and dry it open in the shade [backpack-care]. If seams or zips fail within a year of delivery, you may be eligible for a claim under our warranty policy [backpack-care].
